implementationNotes.scoringLogic: For DEVELOPING profiles, assign journeys based on 2-3 lowest-scoring dimensions. Each dimension maps to multiple recommendations.
implementationNotes.journeyOrdering: Prioritize foundational journeys (grief/healing) before relational journeys (trust/conflict) before preparation journeys (covenant/dating).
implementationNotes.minimumRecommendations: Each dimension has at least 2 recommendations. Most have 3-5 based on genuine relevance.
implementationNotes.multipleAssessments: If user takes multiple assessments over time, track dimension changes and recommend journeys for dimensions showing least improvement.
